Hi Sana —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversation I put together a lean Close Playbook + Mutual Action Plan (MAP) starter we can iterate on during a short working session. The goal for the workshop: align stakeholders, confirm acceptance criteria for the pilot, and agree on a 60-day close window with clear owners.

Quick notes:
- Attached: Helio-MAP-template-v1.gdoc (editable) and a 6-slide Close Playbook starter (gslides)
- Proposed workshop: 60 minutes — agenda below
- Target acceptance criteria we want to confirm: production latency SLO, data retention policy, and pilot success metrics (throughput & integration test pass rate)

Proposed workshop agenda (60 min):
1) 10 min — Introductions + success definition
2) 20 min — Walk through MAP sections and anchor acceptance criteria
3) 20 min — Assign owners, timeline, and gating checkpoints
4) 10 min — Next steps & confirm logistics

Can you share two 60-min windows next week that work for you? After you confirm, Marissa will share a short pre-read and I’ll update the doc with Helio-specific acceptance criteria we discussed.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Best,
Irene Choi

Thanks — jumping in with a draft approach we should bring to the workshop so the customer sees concrete outputs: 

I added a first-pass acceptance matrix in the doc:
- Functional: sample end-to-end inference with canonical data set — pass threshold 95% accuracy on provided examples
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for < 512 tokens (during pilot traffic profile)
- Integration: webhook acknowledgement + retry policy test — successful delivery in <2 attempts
- Security/compliance: signed data processing addendum (DPA) in place; logs aggregated by default, request-level logs available on request under NDA

Next steps for workshop (internal owners):
- Marissa: finalize acceptance matrix and bring the test checklist
- Mateo: prepare brief infra capacity plan (GPU sizing & burst capacity options)
- Irene: confirm stakeholders and drive invite to Helio (customer-facing owner)

I threw these notes into the Helio-MAP-template-v1.gdoc and updated the slides with a proposed timeline graphic. Sana — feel free to tweak these thresholds; we'll treat them as starting points.
